environment.description: Same Quarkus 2.16 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via API Gateway (REST API type). The API Gateway stage has a response gateway response template that appends headers via GatewayResponse configuration for DEFAULT_4XX and DEFAULT_5XX, plus a Method Response model with a static integration response mapping template that injects response headers. Specifically, the integration response has a header mapping: method.response.header.Content-Security-Policy = "'default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; object-src \'none\'; frame-ancestors \'none\''". Additionally, a CloudFront distribution sits in front with a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f86-CSP) that sets Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none' with override=true, meaning even if the origin sends a CSP header, CloudFront replaces it. The Lambda function also runs in a VPC subnet with a security group that has an outbound rule denying traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 (link-local block via explicit deny-all-to-metadata egress rule), and IMDSv2 is enforced with a hop limit of 1 (blocking containerized access).
